home.heroDescription: JOURIVA is a multilingual travel media platform with Moroccan roots — practical, verified guides for discovering Morocco and for Moroccan travelers discovering the world.
home.heroImageCaption: A riad courtyard in Marrakech — one of thousands of details our guides help you read.

home.editorialPromise: Every time-sensitive fact carries a last-verified date and a status. When information may change, we say so — and we always point you to official sources.

quiz.title: Find Your Next Destination
quiz.description: Answer a few questions — departure, budget, duration, travel style, season and interests — and JOURIVA will map your answers to five destinations that fit, with estimated budgets, best seasons, visa information, hotels, tours and related guides.
quiz.notifyTitle: Want to be first to try it?
quiz.notifyText: Join the newsletter and the quiz lands in your inbox the week it ships.
